description: Creates a new WorkMail organization. Optionally, you can choose to associate an existing AWS Directory Service directory with your organization.
mitreAttackSubTechniques: T1496.004 - Resource Hijacking: Cloud Service Hijacking

incidents.description: Threat Actors Using AWS WorkMail in Phishing Campaigns

securityImplications: Attackers might use CreateOrganization to set up a WorkMail email environment in the victim's account, which, unlike SES, has no sandbox and can email external recipients immediately.
